name: MiniMax
note: Quota only. MiniMax reports one window per model in a list rather than a keyed object, so the window key is the model name. The international endpoint is used; a China-region account should override `quota.endpoint` with api.minimaxi.com in ~/.antarium/harnesses/minimax.json. Model names come back verbatim, so badges/labels are declared for the models MiniMax ships today; an unlisted model still charts, abbreviated from its name. MINIMAX_API_KEY is read when Antarium is launched from a shell; an app started from Finder inherits no environment, so a key set in a shell profile will not be seen. A textFile or jsonFile credential works either way.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.

quota.setupHint: Put your platform.minimax.io API key in this file: replace quota.credential with {"kind":"textFile","path":"~/.minimax-key"}, or set MINIMAX_API_KEY and launch Antarium from a terminal.
